Contract:
Compact, typed, single line at end of phase block: ``` **Handoff →** artifacts: [path1, path2]; decisions: [key=value(measured), key=value]; open: [id(reported; depth-only): text, id: text]; deviations: [id: text, id: text] ``` Fields: - `artifacts` — files produced or modified by this phase (paths). - `decisions` — key facts the next phase or audit needs (e.g. `IdempotencyKey=introduced`, `module-system=esm`). Each entry MAY carry a trailing provenance tag `key=value(measured|reported|assumed)`: `measured` — this phase directly observed it (ran a command, read the file); `reported` — carried verbatim from a prior phase's own Handoff, not re-observed; `assumed` — inferred/expected, not directly checked. An untagged entry is `assumed` by convention (`ISS-11`) — omitting the tag never upgrades a guess to a fact. - `open` — unresolved questions / risks / deferred sub-tasks. Each entry is `id: text` or, when its provenance and coverage matter, `id(tag; extent): text` — `tag` is the same `measured|reported|assumed` vocabulary, `extent` is one short phrase naming what the item actually covers (e.g. `depth-only`, `not coverage`) so a narrowed follow-up cannot be misread as covering the whole original question. Empty list → `[]`. - `deviations` — spec/ticket holes this phase self-resolved rather than asking the operator (`AX_DEVIATION_SELF_RESOLVE`); each entry cites the ticket-local Decision Log id it produced (e.g. `TSK-58-D-2: chose retry cap 3, spec silent on it`). Empty list → `[]`.
Free-form text forbidden outside the tag/extent grammar above. Each field is an array (possibly empty).
